highlights.name: Zoro Wallet

Implemented CIP-0103 on Zoro Wallet via RPC-based routing.
Engineered wallet integration framework: transactions, event listeners, and handlers across multiple wallets.
Dynamic fee computation for Canton transactions across assets.
Extended protocol support: token onboarding and on-chain/cross-chain swaps with multi-partner integration.

Provisioned 45,000 bot accounts across 3 nodes (Cypherock, Tradefast, OpenVector).
High-frequency pipeline: 300K+ transactions/day.
